speaker: Leonard
text: What's nice? You know why she didn't say goodbye?

speaker: Sheldon
text: She returned to her apartment, resumed to shower and vomit, not necessarily in that order. Are you expecting me to offer an explanation of human behavior?

speaker: Leonard
text: I know, I just thought as an outsider you might be able to provide a fresh perspective.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I have no difficulty believing you are not butter.

speaker: Leonard
text: Okay, well, I'll walk down with you. So, last night was fun, huh?

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, hi. Um, I gotta run an early shift. Yeah, it must have been. I just threw up in my closet.

speaker: Leonard
text: Bummer. Anyway, I was thinking tonight, maybe we could catch a movie.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, yeah, today's not great for me.

speaker: Leonard
text: It doesn't have to be tonight. I'm free pretty much always.

speaker: Penny
text: Leonard, last night was a mistake.

speaker: Leonard
text: When you say mistake, do you mean a fortunate mistake, like the discovery of penicillin?

speaker: Penny
text: I'm sorry, I was drunk, I was lonely, I hated Zach. Just forget it, it happened.

speaker: Leonard
text: No, it's pretty well imprinted on my brain. Especially the whole rodeo thing. So that's it? Wham, bam, thank you, Leonard?

speaker: Penny
text: Look, I said I'm sorry. Can you please let it go?

speaker: Leonard
text: How am I supposed to let it go? You used me for sex.
